# Wedding-Day Ceremonies

> Marriage Rites (Jiali, the Rites of Festivity) / Wedding-Day Ceremonies · 17 entries

The ceremonial programme of the wedding day itself, from the departure of the escort party to the bridal chamber — the most richly ritualised part of the marriage custom.
